answer.likely_cause: The 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header has a value that does not match the page's origin.

evidence.line: Access to fetch at 'https://idlab.home:8188/v1/whoami' from origin 'https://idlab.home:8182' has been blocked by CORS policy: The 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header has a value 'https://idlab.home:8182/' that is not equal to the supplied origin. Have the server send the header with a valid value.
evidence.why: The header value has a trailing slash, which does not match the page's origin.

fix_steps: Make the API's Access-Control-Allow-Origin match the page's origin exactly, without a trailing slash.
Verify that the browser's developer console shows no CORS errors and the API call succeeds.
